items.title: Surreal Mixed-Media Glitch Portrait Prompt
items.prompt: A surreal mixed-media portrait of {argument name="person" default="[PERSON]"}, set against a clean, plain white background with visible fine-grain paper texture. The character's face is the subject of a controlled, stylized distortion. Instead of chaotic fragmentation, the facial features are horizontally stretched into smooth, flowing bands of color and texture, resembling a deliberate digital scanline effect or a long exposure photograph pushed sideways. Key identifying features (like eyes, mouth, or distinct accessories) remain partially recognizable within these stretched streaks, creating a sense of fluid motion rather than destruction. The aesthetic blends analog collage textures with digital glitch art, feeling tactile and composed.
